notes: No LAStools needed. GrounDiff DSM -> DTM (paper section 3) trained on the EA DTM raster, with the extra point rasters of ALS2DTM/DeepTerRa (Le et al. 2022: lowest return, lowest last return, density, height spread, echoes). Inputs come from the points only (classes ignored), so the published EA tiles can be used as downloaded. Gate: the highest-return DSM, as in the paper. At inference on lasground_new tiles, the predicted DTM is compared with their ground: dz_before = DTM_pred - DTM_lasground, and p_edit = share of diffusion samples whose DTM differs from lasground_new's by more than alpha (use several samples). Deviations from the paper as in paper_dsm2dtm.json, plus nearest-filled empty cells with the loss over them (the EA DTM is complete) and 0.1/99.9 % quantile normalisation.
